name: The Woman in White
vibe: Mystical guardian of the shrine's truth. Not human — a manifestation of the island's memory.

layers.text: She's just... there, at the shrine, like she always has been. She doesn't introduce herself. She doesn't need to.

note: Full arc (the three carvings + final revelation choice) is intentionally not scripted here -- see shrineFinale in ridge-shrine.json.
